quest.title: Irate Iron Chunk
quest.description: Inarticulate Arabalika is exploring the Ruins of Dahri, where "Big Iron Chunks" abound, alone. Though he is a master of Ararakalari, it may be better to check in on him...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Head to the Ruins of Dahri to look for Arabalika

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: A Nara... and something that flies?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Yeah, Paimon's Paimon, and Paimon can fly. Oh, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must be Arabalika. Speaking of which, you don't seem afraid of us at all.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Golden Nara has Arapandu's scent.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, well, Arapandu did actually ask us to come...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: No malice. If you wanted to harm Arabalika, you would have attacked when the Big Iron Chunk was still moving.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, yeah, that sure would've been what they call "hitting an Aranara when they're down"... Wait. Hold on, we wouldn't do anything like that.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Why not? If Arabalika was your enemy, attacking from both sides is a good tactic. Even animals do it when hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... You have a point.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Getting confused, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Anyway! We definitely won't "hit an Aranara when they're down"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aranara are our friends, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right! Aranara are our friends! We won't hurt our friends!

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... Why does he seem dissatisfied...

choices.text: Maybe you didn't leave a good first impression, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon doesn't think she did anything wrong... Urgh... Aranara have such strange tempers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, Arapandu said that Arabalika's Ararakalari is very powerful. He must have used his Ararakalari to defeat that Ruin Guard earlier!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Paimon knows about Ararakalari?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Y—Yeah, of course Paimon knows! It's... It's that thing! That really, really powerful... ability!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Hmph.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woah! Paimon feels like he's looking down on Paimon again...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's focus on the task at hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... We're here to help heal the Varuna Contraption! We should be able to find a branch and some leaves here too, right? Why doesn't Paimon see them?

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: What branch? What leaves? They are more like roots.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Is that true? But Arapandu said...

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: The Varuna Contraption gets power from the root system spread throughout Vana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... That kinda makes sense...

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: And the roots are underground.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: The Stone and Iron Chunks here do not belong to Aranara. To go down, we must defeat Iron Chunks. Iron Chunks are very strong. But Golden Nara is also not weak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course! {NICKNAME} has defeated countless Big Iron Chunks already.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Oh? Then Arabalika wants to see how strong Nara is!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Why did he burrow underground... Oh! Could he have already gone to the Ruin Guard?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's follow him!

choices.text: Maybe he's like this to everyone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How's this possible? How can he look so cute but have such a horrible temper...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Hmph. Arabalika admits you have some skills.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He praised us! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: We can prepare to go underground now. Follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's follow Arabalika quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: We've defeated the Big Iron Chunk. Follow the water. We will go under the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Arabalika has not been here for a long time. Everything has changed. Maybe there are also Big Iron Chunks under the ground. Arabalika smells iron. Bad smell. Be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} is strong. No need to fear. But Paimon is like Aranakula. Weak. Be careful. Mushroom might eat you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Urgh... Anyone would look weak compared to you, okay? We met many Aranara before, but Paimon doesn't think any of them can defeat a Ruin Guard with one blow...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Paimon knows too little about Aranara. Aradasha would defeat a Big Iron Chunk before you could blink.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Aradasha's Ararakalari was very powerful in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In the past? What about now?

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Now? Aradasha is not in the "now." That's why Arabalika must train even harder. Train Ararakalari.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wishes she could learn how to use Ararakalari too...

choices.text: If you could, Paimon, I'd leave every battle to you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, and Paimon would protect {NICKNAME} instead!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm counting on you, Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Leave it to Paimon! You can leave everything to Paimon!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Paimon loves to dream. A good thing? A bad thing? Can't tell. But we need to look for a stone device. Make water go away. We cannot go underground otherwise.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Aranara can dig into the soil, but not water.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Okay, {NICKNAME}, let's have a look around!

choices.text: Paimon won't be able to learn it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon can if Paimon tries!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Most people who say that are...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should Paimon ask Arabalika to teach Paimon after we eat and rest in a safe place?

talks.objective: Find the mechanism and activate it

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They seem... they seem broken! They aren't moving at all! Whew. Th—That really gave Paimon a fright back there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe! So, it's just a bunch of rusty Iron Chunks, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Careless Paimon. Vana is dangerous now. You will get in trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mm... Arabalika is so strict.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're just too careless, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that true? Well... If Paimon's as strict as Arabalika, will Paimon be as strong as him?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, you should be stricter on yourself and not to others.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, then Paimon'll have strict requirements for herself... starting tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, since the stone branch is here, now we need to...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: We need to make three other rocks face it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—He took the words out of Paimon's mouth...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Arabalika doesn't talk like the other Aranara. He doesn't use metaphors at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really is more direct and easier to understand!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Arapandu thinks a lot. Arabalika doesn't think much. Arabalika only knows how to protect.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Arapandu once protected Vana with Nara Varuna. They drove away the unknown black mud. Healed the Varuna Contraption.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: #It has been a long time since Nara Varuna left Vana. Maybe {F#he}{M#she} won't come to Festival Utsava anymore.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Arapandu must know. It has been so many years since then. Enough time for a small seed to grow into a towering tree. Nara who leave Vana will never return.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: But Arapandu wants to heal the Varuna Contraption again. For Vana. For Festival Utsava. For Nara Varuna.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon gets it...

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: #Arabalika never met Nara Varuna, but {F#his}{M#her} story is remembered by Vana.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Arabalika doesn't think as much as Arapandu. Arabalika only knows that he must become strong to protect Aranara and Vana.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Nara Varuna is no longer here, but Aranara can still heal the Varuna Contraption.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! We'll help out too!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: #Something is wrong with the smell of iron. Nara {NICKNAME}, Arabalika will leave this to you. Will wait here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know what you sensed, Arabalika... But oh well. Paimon's sure you know more about the forest than us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, let's start looking around here for the three scattered leaves.

choices.text: It makes him seem less like an Aranara...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, what would be "more like an Aranara" anyway? Oh well, Paimon doesn't get it.

talks.objective: Make the three "leaves" turn towards the "branch"

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Smells of too much iron. Not good.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That was scary! It's a good thing that Arabalika helped out.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Arabalika told you so. Paimon is careless. Will get in trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, alright... Paimon's got it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ruin Guards are here to do their job too, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, guards should be guarding something against trespassers. After all, we're outsiders to them.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are outsiders to Vana. Not Arabalika. The Huge Iron Chunk is making no sense.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Arabalika will teach it sense.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah... Um, Paimon will become more sensible in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll hold you to your word, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course! Tomorrow... No, starting from now!

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Only Aranara can awaken the stone here. Leave the rest to Arabalika, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooooh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're one step closer to healing the Varuna Contraption! Once it is healed, there won't be so many spores in Apam Woods anymore... Just thinking about it makes Paimon's nose itch...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: The Varuna Contraption will purify rainwater. There will not be black rain or so many spores.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: But there should still be mushrooms. Be careful, Paimon. You might get eaten by them. Like Aranakula.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes... Paimon'll be careful!

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Arabalika no longer needed here. Arabalika will return to the "rest stop" to look for Arapandu. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, will you return with Arabalika?

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Yes. It is dangerous in Vana. Traveling together is safer.

choices.text: I have something else to do.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: #Be careful, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Don't be careless. May Aramuhukunda watch over you.
